# What is it?

The National Aquatics Conference is Scouting’s biennial conference for
volunteers and professionals charged with delivering aquatics programs across
the Scouting movement! Scouting America’s National Aquatics Conference
features elective sessions, outstanding keynote speakers, and fellowship with
Scouting’s national aquatics committee and Scouters from across the country.

# Who should attend?

Anyone and everyone involved in national, territory, council, district, and
unit aquatics program delivery.

# When

### September 25-29, 2024

The National Aquatics Conference will feature  elective sessions, keynote
events led by distinguished industry experts, peer-to-peer informal discussion
groups, and many other learning opportunities that will be offered. The
National Aquatics Conference begins Wednesday at dinner on September 25th and
concludes Sunday morning, September 29.

# Where

### Bert Adams Scout Camp

The conference will take place at Bert Adams Scout Camp, located right outside
of Atlanta Georgia. The address is 218 Boy Scout Road, Covington Georgia.
Download directions
[here](https://www.campbertadams.org/files/18538/Directions-to-Bert-Adams).

## Conference Details

### Cost

The cost per person is $290 and includes housing, meals and program during the
conference. All fees are due at the time of registration.

### Conference Attire

Casual dress is perfect for this conference.

### Climate

Some of the scheduled programming will take place outdoors. While daytime
temperatures in September can be in the low to mid 70’s, it may get chilly at
night. Please bring suitable bedding, warm clothing, rain gear, and a hat.

### Transportation

Bert Adams Scout Camp is located in Covington Georgia, outside of Atlanta
Georgia. Transportation from the airport will not be provided; however, we
will provide contact information of anyone who can take riders or who also
wants to share rides from and to the Atlanta airport.

### Facilities and Meals

Meals begin with dinner on September 25 and conclude with breakfast on
September 29 (11 meals total). Please indicate any special dietary needs you
may have in the dietary needs section of your online registration.

Housing will be in BSA-style platform tents with foam mattresses.
Bedding/linens will not be provided. If you need access to electricity for a
CPAP machine, please bring an extension cord.

### Cancellation Policy

Cancellations before August 30, 2024 will incur a $50 processing fee per
person. Late cancellations, after August 30, 2024, will incur a $100
processing fee per person. All other paid fees will be refunded. All refund
requests must be in writing to
[outdoorprograms@scouting.org](mailto:outdoorprograms@scouting.org).
